Ship Document Trap v1 (David's approval 2026-09-21): first video assembled from the donor pool rather than won by a single roll. Ten rolls never landed the lesson's eleven verbatim lines in one take - rolls 7 and 8 reached 7 of 10, and the kit revision that was meant to fix the three stragglers made it worse (rolls 9 and 10, 3 of 11), so this build stops rerolling and takes the best take of each beat. Roll 7 is the spine, carrying the lesson's order and seven lines verbatim; four grafts fill what it misses - roll 3's "the answer wasn't made up, it was just incomplete" and "the document trap is thinking uploaded means fully read" (audio only over Board 1, replacing roll 7's own version of that stretch), roll 8's explanations of moves one and two (audio only, -2.6 dB, replacing roll 7's bare naming of them), roll 8's "asking only about personal fouls" beat over its own isolated-chunk panel, and roll 3's six-foul result over roll 8's verified-quote panel. The last two are inserts; no roll 7 words come out for either. Rolls 7, 8 and 3 sit within 0.2-2.6 dB and 167-186 Hz, so the voice is continuous.
